entities.name: Evan
entities.description: One of the two speakers, a father who talks with his friend Sam roughly fortnightly from May 2023 to January 2024. A watercolour painter of some years' standing who joined painting classes in August 2023 and had a piece shown in an exhibition in December 2023; a keen hiker, skier, road-tripper and gym-goer who has worked on his health since about 2021. Over the conversation he has a heart-palpitation scare (June 2023), twists his knee (August 2023) and re-injures it playing basketball (October 2023), loses his job to a downsizing (October 2023), meets a Canadian woman (August 2023) and marries her (December 2023), and learns she is pregnant (December 2023).

entities.name: Sam
entities.description: The other speaker, Evan's friend. His weight and health are the running subject of the conversation: a doctor's check-up in May 2023, friends mocking his weight in July 2023, a diet from August 2023, a doctor calling his weight a serious health risk in October 2023, an ER visit for gastritis in October 2023, and becoming a Weight Watchers coach by November 2023. He takes a cooking class, journals and writes creatively, is learning to draw, and repeatedly means to take up painting.

entities.name: Evan's wife

properties.aliases: the Canadian woman; my new SO; my partner; the woman from Canada

entities.description: The Canadian woman Evan met on a trip to Canada in the week before 7 August 2023 and married in the week before 26 December 2023; he says he fell in love with her at first sight. They holidayed in Canada together in August 2023, tried snowshoeing in January 2024, told their extended families about the marriage on 5 January 2024, and planned a Canadian honeymoon for February 2024. She was pregnant as of 9 December 2023. Never named in the conversation.

entities.name: Evan's son
entities.description: Evan's son, hurt twice during the conversation: a soccer accident on 12 August 2023 that injured his ankle, and a fall from his bike on 12 December 2023. Both times Evan looked after him and reported him recovering. Never named in the conversation.

entities.name: Evan's family

properties.aliases: my family; the kids; our extended fam

entities.description: The group Evan calls 'my family' — his partner, his children (including the son who is hurt twice) and, more widely, the extended family told about his marriage on 5 January 2024. They road-trip together (the Rockies in May 2023, Jasper that same month, the mountains in December 2023), motivate him to stay healthy, keep a memory collage and the motto 'Bring it on Home' from a trip to Banff, held a get-together on 6 January 2024, and were planning a big family reunion for summer 2024.

entities.name: Sam's family
entities.description: The group Sam calls 'my family'. In October 2023 they were pushing hard for his new health routine, which left him feeling pressured; by January 2024 he described them as his rock through everything. Individual members are never named.

entities.name: Sam's father
entities.description: Sam's father, who took him on a long hike when Sam was ten. Sam calls it a great and special memory and it is the only time he mentions his father.

entities.name: The friend who got Evan into painting
entities.description: The friend who introduced Evan to watercolour painting some years before 2023, gave him advice and, on Evan's later telling, gave him a painting that inspired him to start. Told twice and merged here because both accounts describe one friend starting Evan off; never named.

entities.name: The Rocky Mountains
entities.description: The mountain range Evan visits twice in the conversation: a family trip in the week before 18 May 2023 on which they hiked the trails, and a road trip in July 2023 he described as refreshing with stunning views.

entities.name: Jasper
entities.description: The destination of Evan's family road trip over the weekend of 20-21 May 2023, reached by driving the Icefields Parkway past glaciers and lakes, with a stay in a cosy cabin among mountains and forests. Sam had never been there.

entities.name: Banff
entities.description: Where Evan drove in July 2023 and went skiing, saying the snow was great and he could not wait to return the following year. An earlier family trip to Banff is where the framed 'Bring it on Home' sign in his family collage came from.

entities.name: Canada
entities.description: Where Evan travelled in the week before 7 August 2023 and met the Canadian woman he later married, and where the two of them holidayed together in August 2023, hiking and biking. They planned to return there in February 2024 for their honeymoon, to ski, see the snowy landscapes and try poutine.

entities.name: Lake Tahoe
entities.description: The lake Sam and a friend set out to kayak on 14 October 2023, having heard it was great for kayaking; Evan said they would love the clear water and views there.

entities.name: Evan's favourite spot by the beach
entities.description: A peaceful place close to Evan's home where he goes to relax and unwind and to watch the waves and the sunset; he photographed it on 3 November 2023. He and Sam agreed in November 2023 to visit it together, planning it for December 2023. Unnamed in the conversation.

entities.name: The island Evan grew up on
entities.description: A small island Evan grew up on and calls his happy place and a slice of paradise; he says it shaped him and will always hold a special place in his heart. Unnamed in the conversation.

entities.name: Sam's cooking class
entities.description: The class Sam took from around August 2023 to learn to make healthier meals. He learned several recipes there, grilled a marinated dish with vegetables on 14 August 2023, and offered Evan a roasted vegetable recipe from it.

entities.name: Evan's painting classes
entities.description: Classes Evan started a few days before 19 August 2023, to meet like-minded people and improve his skills. They cover watercolours, and the instructor stresses observing nature and painting what you see. They were the only classes he was taking as of August 2023.

entities.name: Weight Watchers
entities.description: The weight-loss organisation whose local group Sam belongs to. He had become a coach in his group by 9 November 2023, which he called a big accomplishment and a step in his quest for better health, and he attended a meeting on 4 December 2023 that he found insightful.

entities.name: The company Evan worked for
entities.description: Evan's employer until October 2023, when the company downsized and he was let go; he was job-hunting as of 9 November 2023 and still spoke of his work friends at the end of December 2023. Never named in the conversation.

entities.name: Evan's gym
entities.description: The gym Evan trains at. He showed Sam his membership card on 27 July 2023 as a reminder of his commitment, started lifting weights there about a year before October 2023, was there on 16 October 2023 gaining strength, and named it in November 2023 as one of the two ways he stays in shape. Unnamed in the conversation.

entities.name: Hiking
entities.description: The outdoor activity both men return to. Evan hikes the Rockies with his family (May 2023), hikes in Canada with his partner (August 2023) and says a thirst for adventure on interesting hikes motivates him. Sam hiked a long way with his father at ten, had not hiked in years, and took friends on a hiking trip on 29 December 2023. The two repeatedly agree to hike together and never fix a date.

entities.name: Watercolour painting
entities.description: Evan's main creative outlet, taken up a few years before 2023 after a friend gave him a painting and some advice; he calls it a stress-buster, paints landscapes and what is on his mind, and took classes from August 2023. Referred to as painting, watercolour painting and simply art. Sam repeatedly means to try it as a way to de-stress, is offered supplies and a joint session, but never reports painting anything.

entities.name: Skiing
entities.description: One of the winter sports Evan enjoys, alongside snowboarding and ice skating. He skied at Banff in July 2023 and planned to ski again on his Canadian honeymoon in February 2024. Sam would like to try it but doubted in August 2023 that his body could take it.

entities.name: Kayaking
entities.description: Suggested by Evan to Sam on 14 October 2023 as a fun, active way to spend time outdoors; Sam and a friend set out that same day to kayak on Lake Tahoe. Evan himself kayaked and watched a sunset from the water during a camping trip in summer 2023.

entities.name: Yoga
entities.description: Raised by Evan on 5 December 2023 as something gentle he was thinking of trying for stress relief and flexibility; Sam, for whom it had already done wonders on both counts, encouraged him. By January 2024 Evan said it had helped him with stress and staying flexible, and he listed it among low-impact exercises for Sam.

entities.name: Journalling and creative writing
entities.description: Sam's own form of self-expression: writing in his journal and doing creative writing, which he calls therapeutic, a way of sorting out his feelings and like having a conversation with himself. Described in October 2023 alongside his admission that he is still only learning to draw.

entities.name: Road trips
entities.description: Driving out to places is one of Evan's fixed habits and one of the two ways he says he stays in shape. The conversation covers the Rockies trip of May 2023, the Jasper weekend of 20-21 May 2023, a drive to Banff in July 2023, a Rockies road trip in July 2023, a drive that inspired his cactus painting in September 2023, and a long mountain drive over the weekend of 23-24 December 2023. Sam had not been on one in years but was taking short country drives by January 2024.

entities.name: Sam's weight
entities.description: The health problem that runs through the whole conversation. A check-up a few days before 24 May 2023 gave Sam an eye-opening reading; friends mocked his weight on 21 July 2023; a doctor told him on 2 October 2023 that it was a serious health risk that would worsen without change. It limits what he will attempt, affects his confidence and motivation, and by January 2024 he said it felt like it was keeping him from fully living.

entities.name: Sam's gastritis
entities.description: Diagnosed after Sam went to the emergency room with a severe stomachache over the weekend of 14-15 October 2023. He called it alarming and a wake-up call to adopt a more nutritious diet and exercise regularly.

entities.name: Evan's knee trouble
entities.description: Evan twisted his knee on 25 August 2023, which was painful and disrupted his fitness routine; he swam to stay active and waited on a physical therapy appointment. He hurt the same knee again in the week before 6 October 2023 playing basketball with his children, after which physical therapy helped somewhat and he kept to easy exercises rather than intense workouts.

entities.name: Evan's new Prius
entities.description: The car Evan bought to replace his old Prius; he had already driven his family to the Rockies in it by 18 May 2023. He relies on it for his active lifestyle and road trips. It broke down in early December 2023 — which he described then as happening soon after he bought it — and in late December 2023 he took it on a long mountain drive that ended in a minor accident.

entities.name: Evan's old Prius
entities.description: Evan's previous car, which broke down; as of 18 May 2023 he had decided to have it repaired and sell it, having already replaced it with a new Prius.

entities.name: Evan's 1968 Kustom K-200A guitar
entities.description: A vintage 1968 Kustom K-200A guitar Evan received as a gift from a close friend and showed Sam on 9 November 2023, in the same exchange in which he admitted losing his job.

entities.name: Evan's bonsai tree
entities.description: A bonsai Evan keeps because it symbolises strength and resilience; caring for it motivates him to keep going through tough times and reminds him that toughness shows in little things. Shown to Sam on 7 August 2023.

entities.name: Evan's fitness watch
entities.description: A smart watch Evan uses to track his health progress; he calls it a constant reminder to keep going and says the visual reminder has been really motivating. Sam considered ordering a similar one after seeing it on 7 August 2023.

entities.name: Sam's new phone
entities.description: A phone Sam had recently bought whose navigation app kept malfunctioning in October 2023, making getting around a challenge; Evan suggested updating it. It was still giving him trouble on 17 October 2023 and adding to his stress.

entities.name: The Great Gatsby

properties.aliases: that new mystery novel; that book I was talking about

entities.description: The novel Evan was reading through the second half of 2023. He introduced it on 27 July 2023 as a gripping new mystery novel he could not stop thinking about and named it when Sam asked; on 27 August 2023 he said it got better with every page. Sam said he would read it sometime.

entities.name: The Godfather
entities.description: The film Sam watched on the night of 9 January 2024; he quoted 'I'm gonna make him an offer he can't refuse' and said it motivated him to keep up his routine. Evan called it legendary and worth re-watching many times.

entities.name: Evan's contemporary figurative painting
entities.description: A contemporary figurative painting Evan finished a few days before 17 December 2023, emphasising emotional state through expressive brushwork and vibrant colour and capturing a moment of introspection. He was very proud of it, and a close friend helped him get it published in an exhibition.
